sections.subtitle: Thoughtful, collaborative counselling for adults navigating their relationship to food and body, anxiety, depression, life transitions, burnout, and self-worth.

sections.title: Care that is warm, honest, and authentic
sections.description: I'll meet you with kindness, respect, and warmth, while not shying away from compassionately confronting things that may be contributing to your suffering. Sessions blend evidence-based approaches tailored to your goals, capacity, and what feels most useful for you in the present moment.

items.title: Person-centred
items.description: A collaborative relationship where you are met with warmth, respect, and curiosity.

items.title: Integrative
items.description: A combination of mind-body approaches shaped to your specific needs, not a one-size-fits all approach.

items.title: Trauma-informed
items.description: Care that prioritizes safety, consent, pacing, and the wisdom of the nervous system.

sections.title: Individual counselling for adults
sections.description: Support for what you are carrying, with space to understand patterns, strengthen coping, and move toward what matters most to you.
items: Support for eating disorders and disordered eating, as well as anxiety, depression, life transitions, burnout, and self-worth
Virtual sessions available across British Columbia
